targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("DETECT_FAULT").value ORDER BY time)                         AS detect_fault,
  LAST_VALUE(("DOOR_POWERSUPPLYFAIL").value ORDER BY time)                 AS door_power_supply_fail,
  LAST_VALUE(("AUXILIARY_SYSTEM_SERVICESUPPLYFAIL").value ORDER BY time)   AS aux_sys_service_supply_fail,
  LAST_VALUE(("AUXILIARY_SYSTEM_EMERGENCYSUPPLYFAIL").value ORDER BY time) AS aux_sys_emergency_supply_fail
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection_general"

SELECT
  LAST_VALUE(time ORDER BY time) AS time,
  LAST_VALUE(("DOORS_RELEASE").value ORDER BY time)         AS doors_release,
  LAST_VALUE(("DOOR_GALLEY_KEEL_OPEN").value ORDER BY time) AS door_galley_keel_open
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection_general"

SELECT
  time,

  -- Alarm
  ("DETECT_FAULT").value                         AS detect_fault,
  ("DOOR_POWERSUPPLYFAIL").value                 AS door_power_supply_fail,
  ("AUXILIARY_SYSTEM_SERVICESUPPLYFAIL").value   AS aux_sys_service_supply_fail,
  ("AUXILIARY_SYSTEM_EMERGENCYSUPPLYFAIL").value AS aux_sys_emergency_supply_fail,

  -- Status
  ("DOORS_RELEASE").value                        AS doors_release,
  ("DOOR_GALLEY_KEEL_OPEN").value                AS door_galley_keel_open
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection_general"
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Cabin%'
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Corridor%'
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Owner%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Cabin%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Corridor%'
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND (meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Lounge%' OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Salon%')
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Cabin%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Corridor%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Crew%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Owner%'
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND (meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Storage%' OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Office%' OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Galley%' OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Laundry%')
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Cabin%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Corridor%'
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Accommodation'
  AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Crew%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Cabin%'
  AND meta.room_or_area NOT LIKE '%Corridor%'
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Technical'
AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Battery%'
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Technical'
AND (meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Fore%' OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Lazarette%' OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Bilge%' OR meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Pod%')
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Technical'
AND meta.room_or_area LIKE '%Technical%'
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Hatch'
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"

SELECT
  meta."description",
  ARG_MAX((fire."disabled").Value, (fire."disabled").Timestamp) AS disabled,
  ARG_MAX((fire."fault").Value, (fire."fault").Timestamp)       AS fault,
  ARG_MAX((fire."prealarm").Value, (fire."prealarm").Timestamp) AS prealarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."alarm").Value, (fire."alarm").Timestamp)       AS alarm,
  ARG_MAX((fire."test").Value, (fire."test").Timestamp)         AS test
FROM marpower."450000_firedetection" AS fire
JOIN marpower.firedetection_metadata AS meta ON fire.topic = meta.topic
WHERE meta.section = 'Storage'
GROUP BY meta."description"
ORDER BY meta."description"
